1.title: ICE told to halt most vehicle stops after pair of fatal shootings
1.summary: It marks a major policy shift for the immigration enforcement agency, which has faced criticism in the past year over allegations of excessive use of force.

2.title: 'Explosive diarrhoea' outbreak remains a mystery as officials struggle to find sources
2.summary: Experts say there were likely multiple points of contamination in the US food supply - complicating investigations.

3.title: Billionaire Warren Buffett stops donations to Bill Gates charity
3.summary: The investor's decision comes weeks after Gates' appearance before US Congress over his links to Jeffrey Epstein.

4.title: U.S. and Iran Reignite War Over Strait of Hormuz
4.summary: The two countries slid back to open war over the waterway, as the U.S. planned to reinstate a blockade on Iranian ports on Tuesday. Iran said it had attacked two tankers and fired at U.S. military sites.

5.title: A Heated Rivalry Over Bull Mascots Is Dividing a Brazilian Town
5.summary: Deep in the Amazon rainforest, a heated rivalry has split a town for a century. It’s got nothing to do with sports or politics.

6.title: Israeli strike on police post in north Gaza kills seven, officials say
6.summary: A senior officer in the Hamas-run police force was among those killed in the strike, which Israel's military says targeted "terrorists".
